summaryZh: Kummel 实验室标注2025-10-16更新的页面介绍微电子加工化学与抗癌药物包覆，研究薄膜结构和电性能的关系，并开发溶瘤病毒脂质体包覆。方法包括ALD、CVD、双极溅射、原位XPS、TEM及离位电学测量。
researchQuestions: 如何控制薄膜的化学与物理结构以获得所需电性能？
如何开发用于溶瘤病毒的脂质体包覆？
topics: 微电子加工与薄膜材料
选择性沉积及介电薄膜

Primary Research Area Physical Chemistry Materials Chemistry
Welcome to the Kummel Lab Web Page!!!
We are a chemical physics laboratory at the University of California, San Diego
We seek to correlate the control of the chemical and physical structure of thin films with their practical electrical properties.

atomic layer deposition (ALD), chemical vapor deposition (CVD), bipolar sputtering, in-situ xray photoelectronic spectroscopy (XPS), transmission electron microscopy (TEM), ad ex-situ electrical measurements.
we are developing liposomal coatings of oncolytic viruses in collaboration with Epicentrx.
We investigate the chemistry of microelectronic processing as well as coating of cancer drugs.
Projects include selective deposition of oxides, ALD for interconnects/contacts and packaging, ALD of gate oxides for CNTs and TMDs, CVD of low K dielectrics, and deposition of heat spreaders.
